answer_1.quote: All the collected evidence is provided as input with a question to the LLM Llama 3 (MetaAI, 2024) to predict a context item.
answer_1.outputs: context items (source, date, location, motivation, people, things, event) and veracity explanations

answer_2.quote: Source, motivation, things, and event are evaluated with Meteor. Date predictions are mapped to timestamps. We use ∆, which is inversely proportional to the distance in years with the ground truth. Location predictions are mapped to coordinates using GeoNames. We use Coordinates ∆ (CO∆), which is inversely proportional to the distance in thousand kilometers with the ground truth. People expects sets of named entities as predictions, evaluated with the Macro F1-score (F1).

answer_4.quote: We recruited 6 students and provided the SNIFFER explanations to half of them and the COVE context to the others.
answer_4.guideline: Your task is to decide if a caption is accurate for an image or if it is out-of-context.
